title: 【私教案例】你为什么总PC？

timeline.summary: Mikey introduces an anonymized 23-year-old salesperson who allegedly used commercial sex after work setbacks, then frames the cycle as self-labeling, rationalization and avoidance of responsibility.
He describes changing appearance first, then supervising fitness, theory study and online chat before permitting real-world practice.
He recommends online matching and full dates for beginners because they provide more sustained interaction than repeated brief street approaches.

After a reported relapse into commercial sex, Mikey suggests meditation, exercise and diet as substitutes, interprets the behavior as seeking power or validation, and reports a first approach and scheduled date.
He recommends packaging one's identity and even upgrading a salesperson to ‘business supervisor’, while acknowledging that a fabricated persona can be exposed.
He discusses private cinemas and gaming hotels as transition venues, says attraction matters more than immediate sex, and reports positive feedback and a second date.

He advises booking one hotel room directly when attraction is strong, then claims the student obtained sex, improved sales and gained management recognition during the 45-day coaching period before promoting consultations.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He frames the student's repeated commercial-sex use as a coping loop: work setbacks lead to escape, followed by shame, lower mood and further setbacks.
claims.conditions: An anonymized single case narrated by the coach; no independent clinical assessment or student interview is supplied.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He says changing self-labels and habitual behavior matters more than accumulating more dating techniques.
claims.conditions: Broad coaching principle; the psychological terminology and causal claim are not sourced, and moral labeling of the student should not be reproduced as diagnosis.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: His staged coaching sequence is appearance and basic habits first, then fitness, theory and online chat, followed by assigned real-world practice once the student is considered ready.
claims.conditions: Describes his service design and claimed case sequence, not a controlled intervention.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: For beginners he values sustained conversations and dates over large numbers of very short approaches because longer interactions create more feedback.
claims.conditions: The comparison is qualitative; he gives inconsistent duration arithmetic and does not measure learning outcomes.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He suggests meditation, exercise and a lighter diet as substitutes after a relapse and interprets commercial sex as a search for control or female validation.
claims.conditions: The motive is speculative; the claim that diet lowers libido is a health claim without evidence, and legal/sexual-health conditions vary by jurisdiction.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He endorses presenting a more favorable occupational identity, including calling a salesperson a business supervisor, and distinguishes this from deception as ordinary packaging.
claims.conditions: The concrete example misstates role seniority and can deceive a date; it cannot be converted into advice to fabricate credentials.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He presents private cinemas and gaming hotels as plausible private-space transitions because the activity gives a nonsexual reason to enter the venue.
claims.conditions: Entering a venue, accepting a movie/game invitation or staying in a room is not consent to sex or any other intimacy; privacy, surveillance, age, sobriety, local law and an easy exit remain unresolved.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He advises booking one hotel room without asking when attraction is strong and says the woman will otherwise verbally choose two rooms even if she wants one.
claims.conditions: Mind-reading and consent-bypassing framing; accommodation choice and sexual consent require explicit, ongoing agreement.

claims.speaker: Mikey describing a student
claims.statement: He claims the student obtained the desired sexual result, improved from 8–10 monthly sales, became a company sales representative and benefited for life after 45 days of coaching.
claims.conditions: Selected testimonial and marketing attribution; screenshots and narration do not establish baseline, causality, exact result, job title or durability.

examples.summary: The anonymized student case is the sole organizing example; all history, relapse, dating result and career result come through Mikey's curation.
Private-cinema, gaming-hotel and room-booking examples are proposed transition tactics, not evidence of the woman's consent or of a completed event.

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey
speaker_attribution.basis: Visible single host and first-person narration; he is the only audible instructor represented by the transcript.

speaker_attribution.speaker: anonymized student ‘小李’
speaker_attribution.basis: Appears only through Mikey's paraphrase and selected private-message screenshots; the student is not independently interviewed.

speaker_attribution.speaker: women in the case
speaker_attribution.basis: Not independently heard or shown as consenting participants; any reactions or intentions are Mikey's or the student's report.

speaker_attribution.speaker: film/public clip subjects
speaker_attribution.basis: Short illustrative inserts in sampled frames are editorial material and do not supply direct evidence for the case.

visual_findings: All 22 sampled frames were reviewed. The video alternates between Mikey at a desk, illustrative film/public clips, venue imagery and multiple private-message screenshots.

Sampled frames 000007, 000010, 000012, 000013 and 000018 contain selected messages. Names and avatars are blurred, but the images still expose sensitive sexual behavior, coaching communications and personal context; they require privacy review and should not enter a formal package without minimization or redaction.
The screenshots show fragments chosen by the coach and do not independently verify the student's full history, dates, sexual outcome, sales numbers, promotion or causal effect of coaching.
Sparse 45-second frames miss message order and intervening screens. Dense continuous review is required for the listed windows if any quoted message, chronology or outcome is retained.

permissions.reason: Private client material, testimonial marketing, deceptive identity packaging and hotel/private-space advice with unresolved consent, privacy, legal and health boundaries.

limitations: Automatic transcript was read in full but was not checked word-for-word against original audio and contains material ASR errors.
Twenty-two sparse frames do not establish complete message order or continuous audio-visual context.
The client, women, employer, sales metrics, dates and claimed outcomes were not independently verified.
Commercial-sex legality and health risks depend on location and are not adequately addressed in the source.
